about: Labelled pairs for choosing similarity thresholds. `npm run calibrate` embeds them and reports precision and recall per threshold. Negatives are deliberately hard: for duplicates, two different questions about the same requirement; for grounding, a sentence that shares the claim's words but does not state it.

grounding.sentence: First, you will have a 30-minute call with one of our recruiters to talk about your background and what you are looking for.
We then send a small project to complete in your own time; most people spend three to four hours on it.
Next is a 60-minute architecture session where you design a system on a whiteboard with two engineers.

grounding.claim: Values interview with the hiring manager
grounding.sentence: The hiring manager will then talk with you about how you work and whether our values match yours.
You will spend an hour pairing with an engineer on a real bug from our backlog.
The final stage is the PostHog SuperDay, a paid full day of work with the team you would join.
Before we make an offer we speak to two people you have worked with.
If everything goes well, we will call you with an offer within 48 hours.
Technical interview: 90 minutes with two members of the engineering team, covering your past work and a coding problem.
Every application is read by a person on the team, and we reply to all of them within a week.

grounding.claim: Candidates report the process takes about three weeks
grounding.sentence: Interviewed there last spring - start to finish it was roughly three weeks, four rounds.

grounding.claim: Interviewers focus on past projects rather than puzzles
grounding.sentence: No leetcode at all, they just dug really deep into stuff I had built before.
Stage three is a live coding interview conducted in a shared editor.
Finally, one of our co-founders meets every candidate for an informal chat about culture.
Our CEO started the company in 2014 after a decade in logistics.
You can take your equipment home, and we give everyone a budget to exercise and stay healthy.
Our design system is documented in Storybook and owned by the platform team.

grounding.claim: Interview with the team about culture
grounding.sentence: Our research team interviews customers every week to learn about their culture of delivery.
We build screen-recording tools that recruiters at large companies use on their phones.
We raised our final seed round last year and moved to a new site in Berlin.
Engineers here pair often, and every session of our internal conference is recorded.
Our API reference is checked automatically against the OpenAPI schema on every commit.
Great product, we have used it for two years and the support team is excellent.
We offer competitive pay, equity, and a call-free Friday every week.
